name: Amazon API Gateway
description: Managed AWS service for creating, publishing, and securing REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs that connect client applications to backend services like Lambda functions.

name: Amazon CloudFront
description: Content delivery network (CDN) from AWS that caches and distributes web content, video, and APIs from edge locations to reduce latency for end users.

name: Amazon EC2
description: AWS service providing resizable virtual server instances in the cloud, used to run applications and workloads without owning physical hardware.

name: Amazon S3
description: Object storage service from AWS used to store and retrieve any amount of data, commonly used for backups, static websites, and data lakes.

name: Amazon Web Services
description: Cloud computing platform offering a broad set of on-demand infrastructure and platform services, including compute, storage, databases, networking, and machine learning.

name: AWS CLI
description: Command-line tool for interacting with and managing AWS services, allowing scripting and automation of cloud resource configuration and control.

name: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
description: Platform-as-a-service offering from AWS that automates deployment, scaling, and management of web applications by handling underlying infrastructure like EC2 and load balancers.

name: AWS Lambda
description: Serverless compute service from AWS that runs code in response to events without requiring users to provision or manage servers.

name: Azure AI
description: Collection of Microsoft Azure cloud services and tools for building, training, and deploying artificial intelligence and machine learning models and applications.

name: Azure AI Foundry
description: Microsoft Azure platform for building, evaluating, and deploying generative AI applications and agents, combining models, tools, and orchestration in one workspace.

name: Azure API Management
description: Azure service for publishing, securing, monitoring, and managing APIs, providing a gateway along with developer portal and analytics capabilities.

name: Azure App Service
description: Fully managed platform-as-a-service on Azure for building, hosting, and scaling web apps, REST APIs, and mobile backends without managing infrastructure.

name: Azure Blob Storage
description: Azure's object storage solution for storing large amounts of unstructured data such as documents, images, and backups, accessible over HTTP/HTTPS.

name: Azure Data Lake
description: Azure storage service designed for large-scale analytics workloads, allowing storage of structured and unstructured data at scale for big data processing.

name: Azure Data Lake Storage
description: Azure storage service designed for large-scale analytics workloads, allowing storage of structured and unstructured data at scale for big data processing.

name: Azure Durable Functions
description: Extension of Azure Functions that enables writing stateful, long-running workflows using ordinary code, managing orchestration and state automatically in a serverless environment.

name: Azure Functions
description: Serverless compute service on Azure that runs event-triggered code without requiring explicit provisioning or management of servers.

name: Azure IaaS
description: Infrastructure-as-a-service offerings on Azure that provide virtualized computing resources like virtual machines, storage, and networking over the internet.

name: Azure Logic Apps
description: Azure cloud service for building automated workflows that integrate apps, data, and services using a visual designer and prebuilt connectors.

name: Azure OpenAI Service
description: Azure offering that provides access to OpenAI's language and generative models through Azure's cloud infrastructure, with enterprise security and integration features.

name: Azure Storage
description: Cloud storage service from Microsoft Azure offering scalable blob, file, queue, and table storage for applications and data workloads.

name: Azure Virtual Desktop
description: Microsoft's cloud service for delivering virtual desktops and remote applications, allowing users to access Windows environments hosted in Azure from any device.

name: Azure Virtual Machines
description: Infrastructure-as-a-service offering from Microsoft Azure that lets users provision and run Windows or Linux virtual machines on demand in the cloud.

name: Citrix DaaS
description: Desktop-as-a-service offering from Citrix that delivers virtual desktops and applications hosted in the cloud to end-user devices, managed centrally by IT.

name: Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops
description: Virtualization software suite from Citrix used to deliver centrally managed applications and desktops to users across various devices and locations.

name: Cloud Foundry
description: Open-source platform-as-a-service used to deploy, run, and scale applications across multiple cloud infrastructures without managing underlying servers directly.

name: Exchange Online
description: Microsoft's cloud-hosted email and calendaring service, part of Microsoft 365, providing business email, scheduling, and mailbox management without on-premises servers.

name: Firebase
description: Google's platform for building mobile and web applications, offering tools such as a hosted database, authentication, hosting, and analytics.

name: Google Cloud Functions
description: Serverless compute service on Google Cloud that runs event-triggered code without requiring users to manage servers or infrastructure.

name: Google Cloud Platform
description: Suite of cloud computing services from Google, including compute, storage, databases, networking, and machine learning tools for building and running applications.

name: Google Maps Platform
description: Set of APIs and SDKs from Google that let developers embed maps, geocoding, routing, and location-based services into websites and applications.

name: Heroku
description: Cloud platform-as-a-service that lets developers deploy, manage, and scale applications without handling the underlying infrastructure.

name: Microsoft Azure
description: Microsoft's cloud computing platform providing a broad set of services including compute, storage, networking, databases, and AI for building and hosting applications.

name: Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider
description: Microsoft partner program that lets certified partners resell and manage Microsoft cloud services like Azure and Microsoft 365 directly to customers, including billing and support.

name: Nerdio
description: Management platform that simplifies deployment, automation, and cost optimization of Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, and related Microsoft cloud environments for IT teams and MSPs.

name: Vercel
description: Cloud platform for deploying and hosting frontend web applications, offering automatic scaling, serverless functions, and integration with frameworks like Next.js.

name: Vertex AI
description: Google Cloud's managed machine learning platform for building, training, and deploying AI models, including tools for generative AI applications.
